verbatims: Honestly this is the most useful Portugal page I have read on the legal stuff, and I'd send it to my fiance. But who are you? I can't see a single wedding you've done in Portugal, I don't know who our planner would be, and I have to get on a call to find out how you charge. 'One Wedded Advisor from first enquiry to the wedding weekend' sounds nice, but what does that person actually do? Saving the tab for the passport rules. Not enquiring yet.

Honestly, it is a good Portugal guide. The passport stuff and the Sintra palace warnings are things I did not know. But I am not hiring a guide, I am hiring a planner, and I can't see a single wedding they have done here or who would actually plan ours. 'Explains fees on the first call' tells me I won't find out what it costs without getting on a call. I'll bookmark it, but the firms with a Portugal portfolio and a named lead planner get our enquiry first.

This is a really thorough guide, honestly more useful than some of the planner sites I have open. But I came looking for a full service destination wedding planner and I can't tell who these people are, what they actually handle, how they charge, or whether they have ever done a wedding in Portugal. 'Real weddings: hidden.' That is the tab I would have clicked first. I'll keep it for the legal stuff and go enquire with the firm that showed me a Sintra wedding they planned.
